title: Lively Lime Middle Eastern Chickpeas Fatteh
description: A savory and snappy Middle Eastern dish featuring lime juice and chickpeas, served in a Korean brass bowl, vegetarian friendly and kid friendly.

ingredients.name: pita bread
ingredients.notes: toasted and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the pita bread in the oven for 5 minutes, then cut it into small pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lime juice, tahini, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and stir to combine with the lime juice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the toasted pita bread pieces to the skillet and stir to combine with the olive oil.
To assemble the fatteh, place a layer of the pita bread mixture in the bottom of a Korean brass bowl.
Add a layer of the chickpea mixture on top of the pita bread layer.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of chickpeas on top.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
